__**BRICS Chamber of Commerce and Industry​**__

__
 
• The BRICS Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BRICS CCI) is a not-for-profit, non-governmental organization established in 2012 to foster economic cooperation, trade, and investment among the BRICS nations—Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa—as well as other friendly countries.
 
• Recognized by the United Nations and registered under the Societies Registration Act of 1860 in India, BRICS CCI serves as a platform for businesses, entrepreneurs, and professionals to engage in dialogue, collaboration, and growth .
 
• In May 2025, BRICS CCI organized a webinar on "Payment Mechanisms in Rupee-Ruble Bilateral Trade," in collaboration with Sber Bank, to simplify cross-border trade between India and Russia.

**Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**__

__
 
• The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is India's premier central recruiting agency responsible for conducting various prestigious examinations to select candidates for civil services and other government posts.
 
• **Key Functions:**
 
 
• Conducting examinations like the Civil Services Exam (IAS, IPS, IFS, etc.), Engineering Services Exam, Combined Defence Services Exam, National Defence Academy Exam, and many others.
 
• Recruiting for various All India Services and Group A & B posts under the Government of India.
 
• Advising the government on matters related to recruitment, transfers, promotions, disciplinary actions, and service conditions of civil servants.
 
 
 
• **Establishment:**
 
 
• UPSC was established on 1 October 1926 as the Public Service Commission and was renamed UPSC after India's independence.
 
• It functions under **Article 315 to 323** of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Chairman and Members:**
 
 
• The UPSC is headed by a Chairman along with a maximum of ten other members appointed by the President of India.
 
 

**NALSA**__

 
• The National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) is a **statutory body **established under the **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987**, which came into effect on November 9, 1995.
 
• Its primary objective is to ensure equal access to justice for all citizens, particularly the marginalised and economically disadvantaged sections of society.
 
• **Structure and Leadership**
 
 
• Patron-in-Chief: The Chief Justice of India.
 
• Executive Chairman: The second senior-most Judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• Headquarters: Supreme Court of India, Tilak Marg, New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility for Legal Aid**
 
• Under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, individuals are eligible for free legal services if they fall under any of the following categories:
 
 
• Women and children
 
• Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs)
 
• Victims of mass disasters, violence, flood, drought, earthquake, or industrial disasters
 
• Disabled persons
 
• Persons in custody
 
• Persons whose annual income does not exceed Rs. 1,00,000 (Rs. 5,00,000 for Supreme Court cases)
 
• Victims of human trafficking or bonded labor
 
 
 
• NALSA operates through a decentralized network of State Legal Services Authorities (SLSAs), District Legal Services Authorities (DLSAs), and Taluka Legal Services Committees (TLSCs), ensuring the reach of legal aid across the country.

questions.question: Who took charge as the 18th Commander-in-Chief of the Andaman & Nicobar Command (CINCAN), India’s first and only joint services operational command in June 2025?

options.text: Lt Gen N. S. Raja Subramani

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt Gen Dinesh Singh Rana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Lt Gen Dinesh Singh Rana took charge as the 18th Commander-in-Chief of the Andaman & Nicobar Command (CINCAN).**
 
• He is the first Chief of Defence Intelligence elevated to the rank of Commander-in-Chief.
 
• Lt Gen Rana previously served as Director General of Defence Intelligence Agency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Lt Gen Rana was commissioned in 1987 into the 10th Battalion of The Garhwal Rifles and later commanded the same battalion.**
 
• **He has extensive education including NDA, Defence Services Staff College, National Defence College, and international defence studies.**
 
• **He has held varied operational, instructional, and staff appointments including command along the LAC and UNIFIL peacekeeping.**
 
• **For distinguished service, he has been awarded PVSM, AVSM, YSM, Sena Medal, and COAS Commendation Card.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Andaman & Nicobar Command (ANC)**__ is India’s only joint services operational command protecting strategic interests in the Indian Ocean.
 
• ANC is India’s first and only joint services operational command integrating Army, Navy, Air Force, and Coast Guard in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• __**Director General Defence Intelligence Agency (DIA)**__ oversees military intelligence coordination among Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• __**Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM)**__ and Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM) are prestigious awards for distinguished service of the highest order.
 
• __**Sena Medal (SM)**__ is awarded for gallantry or distinguished service in the Army.
 
• Lt Gen Rana holds a PhD focused on China’s defence modernization, reflecting his expertise in strategic military studies.
